response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS fundflux, AVG((s.boxy - s.boxx) * 1.0 / s.boxx) AS avg_y_vs_x_diff, AVG(s.aream2 * 1.0 / s.volm3) AS avg_area_to_volume FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_area_to_volume) AS cross_avg FROM per WHERE avg_area_to_volume IS NOT NULL) SELECT per.fundflux, per.avg_y_vs_x_diff, per.avg_area_to_volume, per.avg_area_to_volume - overall.cross_avg AS above_cross_source_avg FROM per CROSS JOIN overall WHERE per.avg_area_to_volume > overall.cross_avg

assumptions.assumption: Records with NULL boxx, boxy, aream2 or volm3, or with zero boxx/volm3 (SQLite division by zero gives NULL), are skipped by AVG for the affected metric. Each metric is averaged separately over its own non-null records.
The cross-source average is the unweighted mean of the per-source area-to-volume figures. It includes only sources with a non-null figure, and 'above' means strictly greater.
Projects with a NULL fundflux, if any, form their own group and are treated like any other funding source.
